title: Jalluwaayu Dëgg gi
intro: Benn njiit bu am doole, buñu xamee ci seen xam-xam bu rëy ak seen jal bu rafet, dafa am mesaas bu yéeme bu jóge ci fuñu ko xamul. Jokkoo boobu ñu xamul woon, dafay soppi seen ngëm ak seen kiliftéef, daal di leen yóbbu ci tukkib diplomaasi buy natt seen xel, ba noppi mujjee leen yóbbu ci yewwute bu xóot ci ngëm. Ndax mën nga xam kan mooy buur boobu ak mbir yi soppi seen réew yépp?
clues: Man ak sama askan danu daan jaamu jant bi, topp sunuy maam.
Benn picc, di hoopoe, mooy ki ma yónnee bataaxal bu jóge ci benn njiit bu am doole.
Ngir natt xam-xamu ki ko yónnee, ma yónnee ko kado yu am solo, waaye ñu delloo ko ndax ki ko yónnee dafa am alal bu gëna bari ci Yàlla.
Balaa sax may yegsi ci këru ki ma yónnee, ñu yóbbu sama jal bu rafet bi ci diir bu gàtt.
Bima yegsee, ñu laaj ma ndax jal bi ñu yóbbu, maa ko moom, ma tontu leen, 'Daa melni moom la.'
Ma dugg ci saal bu mag bu am dër bu ma jàpp ni bërëbu ndox la, ci saa si ma ànd ak tiitaange, ma jébbalu sama bopp ci wetu Yonent bi Sulaymaan ci Yàlla, Boroom àdduna bi.

trial.label: Xew-xew bu mag bi
options: Dañu jot bataaxal bu jóge ci Seydina Sulaiman

Dañu koy tuumal ni def lu ñaaw
trial.answer: Dañu jot bataaxal bu jóge ci Seydina Sulaiman

location.label: Objet bu am solo
options: Gaal gi ñu defaree ay plank ak pontu

outcome.label: Resultat bi mujjee
options: Toppal jenn Yàlla ju dëgg ji (Allah)
ñu soppi ko nekk ponku xorom
Tabax tower bu kawe ngir yegg ci Yàlla
Ñàkk alal lu bari muy yar
outcome.answer: Toppal jenn Yàlla ju dëgg ji (Allah)

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
